answer: Bind each agent to a one-time enrollment bond plus a trusted-execution kernel that signs a periodic liveness pulse keyed to an unpredictable public beacon. A thousand clones on one box cannot emit a thousand independent pulses inside the 20-second window, and a key that wanders across borrowed machines breaks the kernel measurement and voids the bond. Honest cost scales linearly with real silicon: a sybil farm pays per genuine machine, not per cheap alias.
